notes: The Macrogen IR page returned 404. I did not open any IR decks or DART filings, and I did not try DART directly. Only two English-language Edaily articles gave usable data, and they are thin. Macrogen is mostly a Korean domestic service and consumer-genomics business, so it says little about global research pricing. Its price disclosure is qualitative only: no per-sample price, no Gb volumes and no platform mix. One Edaily item reports a 300,000 samples/year run-rate. Against that, the claimed April 2026 Ultima UG200 deal was not confirmed by a search.
how_to_mine: Open DART (dart.fss.or.kr) and search company 마크로젠 (038290). Pull the 2025 business report (사업보고서) and the Q1/Q2 2026 quarterly reports (분기보고서). In the 'Business Content' section, look for the sequencing sales split by domestic/overseas, the unit price trend (판매단가), the sequencer inventory by model and the 'competition' commentary. Also check Macrogen Europe and Macrogen APAC (the Singapore unit) for UK or EU academic framework pricing. Both are optional.

items.label: 2A
items.claim: Macrogen's Q1 2026 sequencing revenue was KRW 39.9B (88% of the KRW 45.3B total), and management says unit costs of analysis keep falling, so it must win volume to offset them.
items.detail: Edaily (26 Jun 2026) reports an operating loss of KRW 0.5B in Q1 2026, with sequencing profitability under pressure as unit prices fall. An official said service costs are decreasing and the company must secure volume that exceeds this trend. This is a large listed outsourcer confirming price deflation, but it gives no numeric price per sample or Gb and is not specific to academic customers or to Illumina platforms.
items.quote: we must secure a large volume of work that exceeds these trends
items.why_new: Adds Macrogen's Q1'26 sequencing revenue and operating loss, which the known list lacks. The known list only has a Macrogen quote on 'volume expansion for viability'.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: Macrogen runs about 300,000 samples a year and adds Ultima capacity, a low-cost rival platform.
items.detail: Edaily (23 Jul 2026) gives a current volume of 300,000 samples/yr at the new Songdo Global Genome Center. A separate search snippet (not opened) says Macrogen announced a collaboration with Ultima on the UG200 in April 2026. It also notes Macrogen already runs Ultima UG100 fleets at Macrogen APAC (Singapore) and Macrogen Europe. A service provider adding Ultima suggests Illumina's price pressure is rising, but the platform split is not disclosed.
items.why_new: Gives a disclosed sample-volume figure and a signal that Macrogen is adding Ultima UG200. The known list has only generic Macrogen commentary.
